brief: LISN starts as a stem splitter (VST3 and desktop app) and grows into an audio company. The mark has to say audio, carry the app's warm dusk palette, and outlive any single feature.
criteria: Reads as audio at a glance, survives 16 px, works in one colour, belongs to the app's palette.

concepts.name: Split and Rejoin
concepts.idea: One sound enters the disc, opens into its parts, and leaves as one again.
rationale: The four strands are the app's stem colours: vocals, drums, bass, other
Not tied to splitting: it says 'we work inside the sound', so it fits every future product
A perfect disc and one wave keep it calm and recognisable at 16 px
